blocked_reason: WBA real refresh still requires a CubeWBA project, target pins, timing, refresh logs, and visual evidence; WB55 real refresh is already proven.

missing_or_deferred_evidence.reason: third_party/STM32CubeWBA is not present, so no separate CubeWBA project/build can be claimed.
No WBA --expect-real-panel bench artifact exists for screen_expression_status, card_write, and settings_sleepy_screen_status.
WBA panel evidence record is only a scaffold path until real controller, pins, timing, logs, and visual evidence are filled.
WBA FT6336 scaffold has callback shape only; real address, identity, corners, and gestures are still required.
WBA LSE contract is recorded, but real LSE startup, RTC continuity, BLE sleep/connection, and timed wake-up evidence do not exist yet.

promotion_requirements: Add or document the STM32CubeWBA upstream dependency.
Create a separate CubeWBA IOC/project for WBA55 or WBA65.
Add a scriptable WBA build wrapper; do not retarget the WB55 Cube project in place.
Wire WBA BLE/GATT through screen_gatt_stm32wba and preserve CardStatusV1 identity.
Wire WBA scheduler/time through screen_scheduler_stm32wba and preserve display drain.
Wire WBA external UI assets through screen_assets_stm32wba with a real partition readback.
Wire WBA panel transport through panel_target_stm32wba and comp_epaper_panel_refresh_fn_t.
Capture a real BLE artifact with --expect-real-panel including screen_expression_status, card_write, and settings_sleepy_screen_status.
Fill and pass a WBA panel evidence record with runtime diagnostics and before/during/after visual evidence.
Capture WBA FT6336 address, identity, corner-coordinate, and gesture evidence before touch parity is claimed.
Prove WBA LSE startup, RTC continuity across sleep, BLE advertising/connection through sleep, and timed wake-up, or record an explicit no-LSE radio-clock/power exception.
Ensure every WBA promotion artifact declares target_family=STM32WBA and exact_target=WBA55 or WBA65.
Reject WB55 runtime/build/visual/wiring evidence as WBA promotion evidence; it is baseline history only.
purpose: Prevent a WBA55/WBA65 screen parity claim from WB55 evidence or scaffold-only WBA adapters.

target_evidence_requirements.adapter_identity: WBA evidence must name *_stm32wba.* adapters for panel, scheduler, GATT, assets, and touch; *_stm32wb.* adapters are allowed only in the baseline comparison section.
target_evidence_requirements.exact_target_identity: Every WBA promotion artifact must declare target_family=STM32WBA and exact_target=WBA55 or WBA65; target-neutral, WB55, or scaffold-only evidence is not enough.
target_evidence_requirements.no_wb55_substitution: WB55 runtime logs, WB55 build logs, NUCLEO-WB55RG wiring, WB55 photos, and panel_target_stm32wb evidence may be cited only as baseline history; they must never satisfy a WBA promotion requirement.
target_evidence_requirements.target_named_paths: WBA build logs, BLE captures, panel evidence records, touch logs, and visual evidence must live under target-named WBA55/WBA65 paths or carry target-named metadata generated by the WBA build/bench wrapper.
